So how do you feel about it? Any experiences you'd like to share? Any tips?
How do you all feel about astral projection?

I got really excited about it a while back, and I was able to astral project a few times. I was never able to just do it straight from normal consciousness to astral projecting.

Basically my experience was that I would fall asleep, then somehow wake up in the middle of the night with my mind only, and not my body if that makes sense. Then I'd kind of 'fall' or slip out. It was a weird sensation, a few of the times I remember wondering if I was just sleepwalking, it felt so real. It definitely felt like walking in sludge or something, everything was much harder movement wise, and as soon as I got out, I could almost feel a timer counting down until I had to kind of snap back to my body.

Environment wise, if you end up in your immediate physical area (that's how mine always go) then things are mostly the same, but shifted and dreamlike. For example, my alarm clock was still where it is physically, but it was like there were no numbers displayed on it. The parking lot in front of my apartment was still there, but instead of pavement it was covered in grass and no cars. Things like that change, but are still identifiable as what they are in real life.

I haven't been able to really control it, I mostly just seize the opportunity when I feel like I might be able to do it at night. If you have any specific questions feel free to let me know, and I'll answer them the best I can!

It's terrifying. It means somebody has called the daemon possessing you . You can't do it by yourself . I've only ever heard of success stories or done it myself from guided meditations .

If you've experienced it, its quality is epitomized by watching a self come out of yourself , and there is a sensation of being two places at once .
